verdict.rationale: First-party docs show direct bank/credit-card/PayPal/Square connections with automatic transaction import and reconciliation, plus a broad marketplace of 800+ app integrations (Shopify, Amazon Business, PayPal) and a Payroll AI that pulls time/attendance data into the system; community evidence corroborates rule-based auto-categorization of imported transactions. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation that payroll data specifically flows automatically into the ledger (evidence is vendor-only) and explicit detail on connecting third-party (non-Intuit) payroll providers.
